visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Hands display multiple Studio Ghibli character postcards against a bright blue background. A large yellow title overlay with thick borders reads "吉力模仿大賽". The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a studio or well-lit retail environment. (2) A hand presents a postcard showing Kiki from "Kiki's Delivery Service". A young man with brown hair and a denim vest imitates Kiki's phone-holding pose, squinting one eye and smiling broadly. The background shows shelves filled with Ghibli-themed plush toys. (3) A postcard of Sophie and Howl from "Howl's Moving Castle" is held up. Two young women in a retail store pose together; one in a green blouse looks upward while the other in a light jacket leans in close, mimicking the romantic animated scene. (4) A postcard from "Spirited Away" showing Chihiro and Haku is presented. Two young men sit in the store; one imitates eating with cartoon blue tears edited onto his cheeks, while the other looks on with a stoic expression. (5) A postcard from "My Neighbor Totoro" is held up. A woman in a green blouse and the man from the second phase make exaggerated faces with their tongues out, mimicking Satsuki and Mei's expressions. (6) A postcard of the wolf from "Princess Mononoke" is shown. A young woman wearing a grey hoodie pulls the hood up and snarls intensely at the camera, mimicking the wolf's fierce, fanged expression. (7) The original set of postcards is fanned out again by hands. A large yellow text overlay appears, asking viewers to comment on who they think provided the most similar imitation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, high-arousal male voice shouts an energetic introduction in Mandarin over fast-tempo electronic beats. The music is bright and percussive. (2) The audio cuts to a light, whimsical orchestral track featuring flutes and staccato strings. A man's voice is heard laughing and engaging in brief, playful dialogue. (3) A melodic, mid-tempo orchestral waltz with dominant violins begins. Soft female giggling and low-volume casual chatter overlap with the music. (4) The music transitions to a sentimental piano melody. A male voice performs exaggerated, rhythmic sobbing sounds, punctuated by a sharp digital 'ding' sound effect. (5) A bouncy, major-key orchestral theme with a strong rhythmic pulse and bright woodwinds plays. Playful vocalizations like 'bleh' are audible. (6) Dramatic, high-intensity orchestral music with swelling brass and strings takes over. A sharp, snarling growl sound effect is layered at the climax of the phase. (7) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs, followed by a return to the energetic opening electronic music and a final bell chime.
